name: addLinkBlock
label: Add Link Block
description: Adds a block (link button, text, product, coupon, countdown, FAQ, …) to a nimply.link page. Publish with "Publish Link Page" to make it live.

body.config: {{if(parameters.blockType = 'LINK', merge(ifempty(parameters.config, {}), {title: parameters.title, url: parameters.url, subtitle: ifempty(parameters.subtitle, undefined), style: ifempty(parameters.style, undefined)}), ifempty(parameters.config, {}))}}

parameters.name: url
parameters.label: URL
parameters.help: Where the link button goes (Link button only).

parameters.name: subtitle
parameters.label: Subtitle
parameters.help: Small text under the title (Link button only).

parameters.name: style
parameters.label: Style
parameters.help: Link button style; Featured stands out at the top of the page.

parameters.name: config
parameters.label: Config (other block types)
parameters.help: Block config for non-link types as key/value pairs, e.g. targetAt + label for a countdown. Every type is documented at https://developer.nimply.io/docs/link-pages.

parameters.name: position
parameters.label: Position
parameters.help: 0-based position on the page; leave empty to append at the end. 1 is usually just under the social icons.

parameters.name: scheduledStartAt
parameters.label: Show From
parameters.help: Only show the block from this time.

parameters.name: scheduledEndAt
parameters.label: Hide After
parameters.help: Hide the block after this time (no republish needed).
